ara_em.note: Risk-weighted EM metric (30/15/10/10 fixed, 30/10/5/5 floating) and 100-150% range; V21 (tail outflow derivation) not mapped.

caid.note: S-I = CAB identity (BPM6 card); Romania card gives dCA = dS - dI.

cumulative_external_financing_need.note: BPM6 NLB = CAB + KAB = net financial account; M0126/M0110 (same node in EN and RU) state the BoP identity CA + capital flows + reserves = 0. No card sums annual CA balances explicitly. M0341 (gross external financing need) not mapped: different formula.

cyclically_adjusted_balance_hp_filter.note: Cyclical adjustment formulas (elasticities, semi-elasticity, CAB = overall - automatic stabilizers) plus HP-filter output gap variants. Country-specific and financial-sector-support variants of M0087 not mapped. HP lambda not stated in any card.

debt_path.note: Decomposition of debt change into primary balance / interest / growth / inflation (Escolano eq 26-28, MAC/LIC DSF formats, snowball). Other M0331 variants (levels projection, borrowing-requirements form, forecast-error decomposition) not mapped.

debt_stab.note: p* = lambda d*; V13 is the d_t=(1+lambda)d_{t-1}-p_t identity; M0875-V1 is primary balance gap vs DSPB. Debt-target variants of M0296 are mapped to debt_target_adjustment.

debt_target_adjustment.note: Primary balance / CAPB path needed to reach a debt target by a date (Fiscal Monitor, Escolano eq 5-6, Guidance Note). No card states the exact 40% target and r-g to 1 pp by 2028 recursion as one procedure; V2 (CAPB to return to 2011 levels) is closest.

eir.note: Effective rate = interest / previous-year debt; growth-adjusted rate lambda=(i-gamma)/(1+gamma) in M0135-V5. Real/FX-augmented effective rates (M0305-V1,V19-V24) not mapped.

fsi.note: Baldacci-McHugh-Petrova index (WP/11/100). Thresholds tables not in the short formula.

gdp_per_capita_growth_decomposition.note: M1455: dln(GDP/pop) = dln(GDP/workers) + dln(workers/WAP) + dln(WAP/pop); M1160 broader (capital deepening, participation, employment rate, TFP). M0832 (Y/P = A E^a K^(1-a)) not mapped.

gfn.note: GFN = amortization + overall deficit (Guide eq 1-2, MAC SRDSF). V2-V4, V10 (index, stress, criterion) not mapped.

growth_accounting_tfp_residual.note: Cobb-Douglas growth accounting with TFP residual. M0170-V2/V4/V5 (per-worker gap, reallocation) not mapped.

income_velocity.note: Velocity = nominal GNP / money stock; M1158 implied velocity change = nominal growth - money growth.

inflation_erosion_of_debt_ratio.note: Inflation term pi/(1+gamma) x previous debt inside debt-change decompositions. M0684 (inflation surprise contribution) not mapped: different object.

irev.note: Debt burden = indebtedness / repayment capacity (GDP or government revenue). M0323 is interest to TAX revenue, not total revenue. No card defines interest-to-revenue with total revenue explicitly (matches METHODS.md weak note).

lic_dsf_composite_indicator.note: CI = 0.385 CPIA + 2.719 growth + 4.052 reserves cover ... ; M0872 thresholds (burden) not mapped. Card includes cutoffs 2.69 and 3.05.

maastricht_convergence_criteria.note: M1261 inflation (3 best + 1.5 pp) and interest rate; M1468 deficit 3% and debt 60%; M0943 debt definition and SGP reference values.

mac_dsa_stress.note: Standardized macro-fiscal shocks (growth 1 SD two years, interest, primary balance), combined shock rule, CL shock. V13 (Guidance Note) is the key card. Triggered/LIC stress variants not mapped.

okun_gap_cyclical_unemployment.note: Gap form u - u* = a(y - y*) (WEO Oct 2012 Box 4.1 in V4). Coefficient -0.5 convention is not a card parameter.

private_public_sector_balance_split.note: Only the Romania Box 1 card states dCA = dCA_Gov - dCA_Private (sector split). BPM6 card M0654 states S-I but not the sector split, so it is not mapped.

real_interest_rate.note: Nominal rate deflated by actual inflation (Fisher or simple difference). Expected-inflation-based real rates (M0221-V1,V2,V8-V14) not mapped.

real_interest_rate_fisher_gdp_deflator.note: r=(1+i)/(1+pi)-1; V5 is Escolano Fisher form; V15 uses GDP deflator change.

reer_real_dep.note: Real depreciation = nominal depreciation vs dollar - domestic GDP-deflator inflation. M0457 / M1418 (z with foreign inflation) are related but a different formula; not mapped.

reserve_adequacy_traditional_metrics.note: 3 months of imports, 100% STD (Greenspan-Guidotti), 20% M2, combined max rule, reserves/STD, expanded rule.

world_bank_income_classification_atlas.note: Atlas GNI per capita cut-offs (2011: 1,025 / 4,035 / 12,475). Other M0176/M0133 variants (LIDC) not mapped.
